The Pathcwork is a Datapack adding TARDIS Ship from Doctor Who and is planed to have more immersive content in the future. Have a Functional TARDIS Ship only DataDriven!

**Because modrinth or me does something wrong with Datapacks, i made a little tutorial**
# How to Install

To Load in the datapack into your world you need to put this datapack from 
`/profiles/<yourinstancename>/datapack/`
to:
`/profiles/<yourinstancename>/saves/<yourworldname>/datapacks/`

This is because though you download the datapack onto your modfinth profile, it does not load in the world when creating.

After loading the datapack you need to enable it with Commands with premissions enabled \
`/datapack enable "file/ThePatchwork.zip"` *(it should autocomplete)*

The texture pack is not available yet! it does not install automaticly with the datapack so item textures are gonna be wierd...

## Content List
The Patchwork Datapack curently has only 2 items in its contents list:

<details>
  
<summary>Content List</summary>

<details>
<summary>The TARDIS Capsule</summary>
Use the Interface to Control the Coordinates of travel, Doors, check players in the capsule, and Travel to set coordinates! 


</details>
<details>
<summary>The Sonic Screwdriver</summary>
  use the sonic with right-click, and change the mode with crouch right-click.
The sonic has only one mode working for now, TARDIS Tool - which can summon the Tardis Capsule to your location from anywhere in the overworld!


</details>


</details>
